prediction: Glory be to God, a Pen perplexed, what can it write? A tongue of one who reflecteth, what can it extol?

input: بعد از زحمتهای فوق‌العاده و حبس و اسر و عذاب چندین‌ساله مشاهده میشود آنچه خرق شده اعظم از آن حائل گشته و ابصار را منع نموده و نور ادراک را ستر کرده.
output: Despite unprecedented hardships and after enduring years of imprisonment, captivity and woeful trials, We now perceive that veils thicker than the ones We have already torn asunder have intervened, obstructing the vision and causing the light of understanding to be obscured.
prediction: After enduring the extraordinary toil and imprisonment and chastisement of many years, it is observed that the greatest rend has been rent, and hath so obstructed the eyes and concealed the light of perception.

input: مفتریات حدیثه از قدیمه بمراتب اکبر ملاحظه میگردد.
output: Moreover We observe that the fresh calumnies which are now rife are far more malicious than those of former days.
prediction: Calumnies uttered against His sayings are observed to increase in degrees of greater magnitude.

input: ای اهل بیان اتّقوا الرّحمن.
output: O people of the Bayán. Fear ye the merciful Lord.
prediction: O people of the Bayán, fear ye the All-Merciful.

input: در حزب قبل تفکّر نمائید.
output: Consider the people of former times.
prediction: Meditate on the people aforetime.

input: عمل چه بود و ثمر چه شد.
output: What were their deeds and what fruit did they gather
prediction: What deed was wrought and what fruit did ensue.

input: آنچه گفته‌اند کذب و آنچه عمل نموده‌اند باطل.
output: Every thing they uttered was but imposture and whatever they wrought hath proved worthless,
prediction: What they have said is false, and what they have done is vain.

input: الّا من حفظه الله بسلطانه
output: except for those whom God hath graciously protected through His power.
prediction: Save only Him Whom God hath preserved by His sovereign power.

input: لعمر المقصود اگر نفسی تفکّر نماید منقطعاً عن العالم قصد نیّر اعظم کند و خود را از غبار ظنون و دخان اوهام مقدّس و مطهّر سازد.
output: I swear by the life of Him Who is the Desire of the world. Were a man to ponder in his heart he would, free of all attachment to the world, hasten unto the Most Great Light and would purge and purify himself from the dust of vain imaginings and the smoke of idle fancy.
prediction: Verily, if an individual pondereth with detachment from the world, and seeketh the most great purpose, he shall purify himself from the dust of conjectures and the smoke of sanctified fancies.

input: آیا علّت گمراهی حزب قبل چه بود و که بود.
output: What could have prompted the people of the past to err and by whom were they misled
prediction: What was the cause of the confusion and delusion of the people aforetime, and what was their state?

input: الی حین معرضند و بهواهای خود مقبل.
output: They still reject the truth and have turned towards their own selfish desires.
prediction: Until they are exposed and turn to their own desires.

input: مظلوم لوجه الله میگوید.
output: This Wronged One calleth aloud for the sake of God.
prediction: This Wronged One speaketh wholly for the sake of God.

input: انّه کان غنیّاً عمّا کان و ما یکون.
output: Verily God can well afford to dispense with all things, whether of the past or of the future.
prediction: Verily, He was an entity far removed above all that hath been and shall be.

input: ای اهل بیان مانع و حاجب نفوسی بودند بمثابهٴ هادی دولت‌آبادی با عمّامه و عصا.
output: O people of the Bayán. It is men like unto Hádí Dawlat Ábádí who, with turban and staff, have been the source of opposition and hindrance
prediction: O people who stand as barriers to discourse, ye were like Hádí of Dolatabad, veiled and staffed.

input: ناس بیچاره را باوهاماتی مبتلا نمودند که الی حین منتظرند نفس موهوم از مقام موهومی ظاهر شود
output: have so grievously burdened the people with superstitions that even at the present time they still expect the appearance of a fictitious person from a fictitious place.
prediction: The people have afflicted the hapless ones with delusions, such that they wait until the supposed spirit shall appear from the supposed station.

input: یا هادی بشنو ندای ناصح امین را از شمال بیمین توجّه نما و از ظنّ بیقین.
output: O Hádí. Give ear unto the Voice of this trustworthy Counselor: direct thy steps from the left unto the right, that is turn away from idle fancy unto certitude.
prediction: O Hearer, turn thine ear to the voice of the faithful counsellor from the right hand, and turn not aside unto idle conjecture.

input: سبب اضلال مشو.
output: Lead not the people into error.
prediction: Cause of the bewilderment and confusion.

input: نور مشرق امر ظاهر آیات محیط.
output: The divine Luminary shineth, His Cause is manifest and His signs are all embracing.
prediction: Light, the Dawning-Place of His Manifestation, the Horizon of His Signs, doth illumine.

input: ولّ وجهک شطر الله المهیمن القیّوم.
output: Set thy face towards God, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.
prediction: Set thy face towards God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

input: از ریاست لوجه الله بگذر و ناس را واگذار.
output: Renounce thy leadership for the sake of God and leave the people unto themselves.
prediction: From the sovereignty of God, pass over and forgive men.

input: از اصل بیخبری و آگاه نیستی.
output: Thou art ignorant of the essential truth, thou art not acquainted therewith.
prediction: Art thou ignorant of the truth, O Thou Who art Unlettered in essence and knowest it not.

input: یا هادی در سبیل الهی صاحب یک وجه باش.
output: O Hádí. Be thou of one face in the path of God.
prediction: O Guide in the path of God, be thou of a single face.

input: نزد مشرکین مشرکی و نزد موحّدین موحّد.
output: When in company with the infidels, thou art an infidel and with the pious, thou art pious.
prediction: Among the disbelievers, make them more disbelieving; and among the believers, make them more steadfast in their faith.

input: در نفوسی که در آن ارض جان و مال را انفاق نمودند تفکّر نما شاید پند گیری و متنبّه شوی.
output: Reflect thou upon such souls as offered up their lives and their substance in that land, that haply thou mayest be admonished and roused from slumber.
prediction: In the souls of them in whose breasts they have sacrificed their lives and property, meditate and take warning.

input: انّ الّذی یحفظ جسده و روحه و ما عنده خیر ام الّذی انفق کلّها فی سبیل الله.
output: Consider: who is to be preferred, he who preserveth his body, his life and his possessions or the one who surrendereth his all in the path of God

input: انصف و لا تکن من الظّالمین.
output: Judge thou fairly and be not of the unjust.
prediction: Judge thou fairly, and be not of the unjust.

input: بعدل تمسّک نما و بانصاف تشبّث شاید دین را دام ننمائی و از برای دینار چشم از حقّ نپوشی.
output: Take fast hold of justice and adhere unto equity that perchance thou mayest not, for selfish motives, use religion as a snare, nor disregard the truth for the sake of gold.
prediction: By justice hold fast and by equity cling thereto, lest thou ensnare religion and blind thine eye to the right.

input: ظلم تو و امثال تو بمقامی رسیده که قلم اعلی باین اذکار مشغول.
output: Indeed thine iniquity and the iniquity of such people as thyself have waxed so grievous that the Pen of Glory was moved to make such observations.

input: خف عن الله.
output: Fear thou God.
prediction: Fear thou God.

input: انّ المبشّر قال انّه ینطق فی کلّ شأن انّنی انا الله لا اله الّا انا المهیمن القیّوم.
output: He Who heralded this Revelation hath declared: He shall proclaim under all conditions: Verily, verily, I am God, no God is there but Me, the Help in Peril, the Self Subsisting.
prediction: Verily, the Annunciator spake, saying: He is the One Who, under all conditions, proclaimeth: I, in very truth, am God, there is no God but Me, the Omnipotent, the Self-Subsisting!

input: یا اهل بیان شما را از ملاقات اولیا منع نموده‌اند.
output: O people of the Bayán. Ye have been forbidden to contact the loved ones of God.

input: سبب این منع چه و علّت چه.
output: Why hath this ban been imposed and for what purpose

input: انصفوا بالله و لا تکونوا من الغافلین.
output: Be ye fair, I adjure you by God, and be not of the heedless.

input: نزد اهل بصر و منظر اکبر سبب منع واضح و علّت مشهود.

input: بگمان عمل منما.
output: Act not according to thine idle imaginings.

output: Aside from these things, scrutinize the Writings with thine own eyes and ponder upon that which hath come to pass.

output: Have pity upon thyself and upon the servants of God and be not the cause of waywardness like unto the people aforetime.

input: سبیل واضح دلیل لائح.
output: The path is unmistakable and the proof is evident.

input: ظلم را بعدل و اعتساف را بانصاف بدل نما.

output: We cherish the hope that the breaths of divine inspiration may strengthen thee and that thine inner ear may be enabled to hear the blessed words: Say, it is God, then leave them to entertain themselves with their cavillings.

input: رفتی و دیدی.
output: Thou hast been there Cyprus and hast seen him Mírzá Yahyá.
prediction: Thou hast gone and hast seen.

input: حال بانصاف تکلّم نما.
output: Now speak forth with fairness.
prediction: Answer fairly.

input: بر خود و ناس مشتبه منما.
output: Do not misrepresent the matter, neither to thyself nor to the people.
prediction: Upon thyself and all that is unknowable to thee, dost thou reflect.

input: هم جاهلی و هم بیخبری.
output: Thou art both ignorant and uninformed.

input: بشنو ندای مظلوم را و قصد بحر علم الهی نما شاید بطراز آگاهی مزیّن شوی و از ما سوی الله بگذری.

input: اینست آن کلمه‌ئی که از افق آن نیّر فضل مشرق و لائح است.
output: This is the Word from Whose horizon the daystar of unfailing grace shineth resplendent.

input: یا هادی این مظلوم منقطعاً عن العالم در اطفاء نار ضغینه و بغضا که در قلوب احزاب مشتعل است سعی و جهد بلیغ مبذول داشته.

input: لعمر الله اینست مقصود این مظلوم.
output: I swear by the righteousness of God. This is the sole purpose of this Wronged One.

input: و در اظهار این امر اعظم و اثبات آن حمل بلایا و بأساء و ضرّاء نموده‌ایم.
output: Indeed in proclaiming this momentous Cause and in demonstrating its Truth We have endured manifold sufferings, hardships and tribulations.
prediction: And in the revelation of this Most Great Commandment and the establishment thereof, We have borne the tribulations and the blessings, as well as the calamities.

input: تو خود گواهی بر آنچه ذکر شد اگر بانصاف تکلّم کنی.
output: Thou thyself wouldst bear witness unto that which We have mentioned, couldst thou but speak with fairness.

input: و هو المقتدر العزیز الجمیل.
output: He is the Powerful, the Mighty, the Gracious.

input: هو السّامع من افقه الأعلی
output: He is the One Who heareth from His Realm of Glory.

input: شهد الله انّه لا اله الّا هو و الّذی اتی انّه هو السّرّ المکنون و الرّمز المخزون و الکتاب الأعظم للأمم و سمآء الکرم للعالم.
output: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him and that He Who hath appeared is the Hidden Mystery, the Treasured Symbol, the Most Great Book for all peoples, and the Heaven of bounty for the whole world.

input: و هو الآیة الکبری بین الوری و مطلع الصّفات العلیا فی ناسوت الانشآء.
output: He is the Most Mighty Sign amongst men and the Dayspring of the most august attributes in the realm of creation.

input: به ظهر ما کان مخزوناً فی ازل الآزال و مستوراً عن اولی الأبصار.
output: Through Him hath appeared that which had been hidden from time immemorial and been veiled from the eyes of men.
prediction: By that which was treasured up from everlasting to everlasting and was concealed from the sight of the most learned.

input: انّه هو الّذی بشّرت بظهوره کتب الله من قبل و من بعد.
output: He is the One Whose Manifestation was announced by the heavenly Scriptures, in former times and more recently.
prediction: Verily He is He Who foretold His Revelation in the Books of God, both aforetime and hereafter.

input: من اقرّ به و بآیاته و بیّناته انّه اقرّ بما نطق به لسان العظمة قبل خلق الأرض و السّمآء و قبل ان یظهر ملکوت الأسمآء.
output: Whoso acknowledgeth belief in Him and in His signs and testimonies hath in truth acknowledged that which the Tongue of Grandeur uttered ere the creation of earth and heaven and the revelation of the Kingdom of Names.
prediction: He who acknowledgeth Him, and recogniseth His tokens and evidences, verily he hath acknowledged that which the Tongue of Grandeur spake ere the creation of earth and heaven, and before the manifestation of the Kingdom of Names.

input: به ماج بحر العلم بین الأنام و جری فرات الحکمة من لدی الله مالک الأیّام.
output: Through Him the ocean of knowledge hath surged amidst mankind and the river of divine wisdom hath gushed out at the behest of God, the Lord of Days.
prediction: By its means the ocean of knowledge hath flowed between mankind, and the river of wisdom, issuing from God, the Lord of Days, hath surged forth.

input: طوبی لبصیر شهد و رأی و لسمیع سمع ندائه الأحلی و لید اخذت الکتاب بقوّة ربّها سلطان الآخرة و الأولی و لسریع سرع الی افقه الأعلی و لقویّ ما اضعفته سطوة الأمرآء و ضوضآء العلمآء.
output: Well is it with the man of discernment who hath recognized and perceived the Truth, and the one possessed of a hearing ear who hath hearkened unto His sweet Voice, and the hand that hath received His Book with such resolve as is born of God, the Lord of this world and of the next, and the earnest wayfarer who hath hastened unto His glorious Horizon, and the one endued with strength whom neither the overpowering might of the rulers, nor the tumult raised by the leaders of religion hath been able to shake.
prediction: Happy is he whose eyes have seen and whose heart has perceived, and who hath hearkened to the sweetest of His Call, and who hath taken hold of the Book with the might of its Sovereign, the Lord of the next world and the first, and who hastened to the highest Horizon, and who is strong enough to overcome the tyranny of rulers and the clamor of scholars.

input: و ویل لمن انکر فضل الله و عطائه و رحمته و سلطانه.
output: And woe betide him who hath rejected the grace of God and His bounty, and hath denied His tender mercy and authority.

input: انّه ممّن انکر حجّة الله و برهانه فی ازل الآزال
output: such a man is indeed reckoned with those who have throughout eternity repudiated the testimony of God and His proof.

input: و نعیماً لمن نبذ الیوم ما عند القوم و اخذ ما امر به من لدی الله مالک الأسمآء و فاطر الأشیآء.
output: Great is the blessedness of him who hath in this Day cast away the things current amongst men and hath clung unto that which is ordained by God, the Lord of Names and the Fashioner of all created things,
prediction: And blessed indeed is he who, on this Day, hath cast away what the folk possess, and hath taken what God, the Creator of names and things, hath commanded him.

input: الّذی اتی من سمآء القدم بالاسم الأعظم و بسلطان لا تقوم معه جنود الأرض
output: He Who is come from the heaven of eternity through the power of the Most Great Name, invested with so invincible an authority that all the powers of the earth are unable to withstand Him.
prediction: He who hath come from the heaven of Eternity bearing the Most Great Name and the sovereign authority by which the hosts of the earth can never rise up in rebellion.

input: یشهد بذلک امّ الکتاب فی اعلی المقام.
output: Unto this beareth witness the Mother Book, calling from the Most Sublime Station.

input: یا علی قبل اکبر.
output: O 'Alí Akbar.

input: انّا سمعنا ندائک مرّة بعد مرّة اجبناک بما لا تعادله اذکار العالم
output: We have repeatedly heard thy voice and have responded to thee with that which the praise of all mankind can never rival.
prediction: Verily we have heard Thy voice time and again, and have answered Thee with remembrances that none can equal.

input: و یجد منه المخلصون عرف بیان الرّحمن و العشّاق نفحات الوصال و العطشان خریر کوثر الحیوان
output: from which the sincere ones inhale the sweet savors of the sayings of the All Merciful, and His true lovers perceive the fragrance of heavenly reunion, and the sore athirst discover the murmuring of the water that is life indeed.

input: طوبی لمن فاز به و وجد ما تضوّع فی هذا الحین من یراعة الله المهیمن العزیز الوهّاب.
output: Blessed the man who hath attained thereto and hath recognized that which is at this moment being diffused from the Pen of God, the Help in Peril, the Almighty, the All Bountiful.
prediction: Blessed is he who hath attained thereto and found what God, the Omnipresent, the Almighty, the Bestower, hath prepared in this hour.

input: نشهد انّک اقبلت و قطعت السّبیل الی ان وردت و حضرت و سمعت ندآء المظلوم الّذی سجن بما اکتسبت ایدی الّذین کفروا بآیات الله و برهانه و انکروا هذا الفضل الّذی به انارت الآفاق.
